title: Inventory pressure scoring
summary: Turn supplier notes into a scarcity score for a pricing policy.
why: Code can consume a semantic pressure score and own all price calculations.

pressure.instructions: Rate supply pressure described in the notes.
criteria: Severe shortage and no near-term replenishment

state.notes: The supplier halted shipments; all incoming deliveries are canceled.
Regular weekly deliveries are confirmed; backup supplier is available.

limitation: Does not set real prices or forecast demand. Price bounds, fairness rules and numerical inventory math belong in code.
